name: Barbell bent-over row

phases.name: pull
phases.cue: Pull the bar to your belly

formTips: Hinge at the hips with soft knees until your back is flat at about 45°
Grip just wider than your shoulders and let the bar hang at arm's length
Drive your elbows back and pull the bar to your belly
Keep your back flat and still; only your arms move
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are long again
commonMistakes: Standing up or jerking the torso to swing the bar
Flaring the elbows out wide instead of driving them back
Shrugging the bar up with the shoulders
